description: War siege, part 2 of 2 (after upwell-siege-1): the attacker declares war through the client's war window (100M from the corp master wallet), starts it with the GM /war start (owner ruling), and shoots the defender's Fortizar with a sieged Revelation through shield, the armor timer (the client GM menu's /structure timer), armor, the hull timer and hull. Each layer is shot for real, a logged GM /upwell damage leaves 1% and real fire finishes it (owner's hybrid ruling). Checks each reinforce state, the defender's client ejected to space on the kill, its hangar in asset safety and the quantum core in a wreck on grid.

setup.note: a pilot on its own account
a pilot on its own account
the defender stays docked in its Fortizar
GM setup: the Revelation, docked in the War HQ

setup.clientEval: up_slash('/tr me 60004603'); up_sleep(15000); up_undock(); agent.up_target = up_find_structure('Siege Target Fortizar'); up_warp_to(agent.up_target, 0) < 50000
setup.note: GM move to Amamake, then warp to the target
the war window's declare against the target's owner, with the War HQ; 100M from the master wallet
GM: end the 24 h spool-up (owner ruling)
a live war: attacking the defender's structure is allowed on green safety
the client GM menu's timer: armor vulnerable

setup.clientEval: r = up_shoot_layer(agent.up_target, 'hull'); r['moved'] and r['state'] is None
setup.note: hull shot down: the Fortizar dies

setup.clientEval: up_sleep(5000); session.structureid is None and up_bp() is not None and up_bp().GetBall(session.shipid) is not None
setup.note: the defender's client was ejected into space
the defender's hangar is in asset safety

setup.clientEval: bp = up_bp(); w = [k for k, v in bp.slimItems.items() if v.groupID == 186 and bp.DistanceBetween(session.shipid, k) < 100000]; agent.up_wreck = w[0] if w else None; bool(w) and 56204 in [i.typeID for i in sm.GetService('invCache').GetInventoryFromId(agent.up_wreck).List()]
setup.note: a wreck on grid with the quantum core in it

expect.note: the client changed session (docked, undocked or moved); the clientEval asserts carry the checks
